author: Huawei
description:
At #MWC26 Barcelona, Li Peng, Senior Vice President and President of ICT Sales & Service at Huawei, gave a keynote speech emphasizing that as AI adoption grows, the industry is facing its third stage shift: carriers are moving from "selling experiences" to "selling AI services."

AI is comprehensively reconstructing B2C, B2H, and B2B businesses. #Huawei is committed to working alongside global carriers to seize 5G-A and AI opportunities, jointly building a future-ready, AI-centric network. https://bit.ly/3PMn2Nf #AdvancingAllIntelligence
title: Advancing Al-Centric Networks to Create More Value in the Agent Age
